verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud's Knowledge Graph is documented to continuously generate insights that highlight anomalies without the user writing complex PromQL queries. That directly matches the core of surfacing problems without hand-written thresholds, but the evidence is a single brief product description with no detail on how it works. missing for 10: details on how anomaly/outlier detection is enabled or configured, ML or dynamic-baseline alert rules tied into Grafana Alerting, outlier detection across series, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can enable anomaly or outlier detection that surfaces problems without hand-written thresholds

citations.quote: It continuously generates insights that highlight saturation, errors, anomalies, failures, and configuration changes—eliminating the need to write complex PromQL queries
generating insights about issues, and connecting metrics, logs, and traces in a unified workflow—no complex queries required.
